## berth host create

create a VM at a cloud provider and register it: nothing open to the internet, reached over Tailscale

### Synopsis

Creates a server at Hetzner Cloud behind a firewall that lets nothing in, has it install Docker and
join your tailnet, and registers it as host add does. berth makes the server's ssh host key itself and
pins it before the first connection. Everything it creates is labelled (berth.managed, berth.host).

From the environment, never the command line: HCLOUD_TOKEN (the project's API token) and
BERTH_TAILSCALE_AUTHKEY (a single-use, tagged auth key). This machine must be on the tailnet.
A failure at any step removes what was created.

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_host_create/

```
berth host create <name> --provider hetzner [--size cax21] [--region fsn1] [--image ubuntu-24.04] [--home <dir>] [--bind <mode>] [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  berth host create box3 --provider hetzner
  berth host create box3 --provider hetzner --size cax31 --region hel1
```
